scope_description: Network security controls between the cardholder data environment and everything else
Secure configuration of system components, and removal of vendor defaults
Protection of account data where it is stored, including retention limits and key management
Protection of cardholder data in transit across open, public networks
Protection of systems and networks from malicious software
Development and maintenance of secure systems and software, including patching
Restriction of access to system components and cardholder data by business need to know
Identification of users and authentication of access to system components
Restriction of physical access to cardholder data
Logging of access to system components and cardholder data, and monitoring of those logs
Regular testing of the security of systems and networks
An organisational information security policy and programme supporting the above
